description: Potential EKS Workload Identity to Privileged IAM Role
rationale: Read-only P5-D cross-resource policy correlation. A scoped permission, workload association or resource-policy Allow is a potential path only, not proof of effective authorization, token access or exploitability. Unknown constraints and inaccessible APIs are not PASS.
remediation: Review the exact principal, action, resource, role trust and service configuration; restrict PassRole/role scope, cross-account principals and workload permissions. Validate organization guardrails and effective authorization separately.
